# Introduction

#### Course: HTML Fundamentals for Your First Webpage

## Introduction

Let's continue with writing simple HTML code, putting aside the blog for some time.

Suppose you have to create a webpage with a heading and a paragraph like this:

![Introduction](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

Let's first create this structure using just plain text.

```html
1This is a Heading
2This is a paragraph.
```

Browser Output

![Introduction](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

You can see we don't get the desired output.

With just plain text, the browser doesn't know which content is a heading and which is a paragraph. That's why we get both texts on the same line.

To create such a structure, we use HTML tags, which we will explore next.
